allShows.title: Ben 10
allShows.description: A young boy named Ben discovers a mysterious alien watch that lets him transform into ten different heroes. With each form offering unique powers, Ben battles villains, saves the world from galactic threats, and learns the true meaning of responsibility.

allShows.title: Chhota Bheem
allShows.description: In the kingdom of Dholakpur, Bheem is a brave and kind-hearted boy with incredible strength. Along with his friends, he takes on villains, monsters, and tricky situations, proving that wisdom and courage always win the day.

allShows.title: Courage: The Cowardly Dog
allShows.description: Courage may be timid, but when supernatural forces threaten his owners Muriel and Eustace, he finds the bravery to fight back. From creepy monsters to bizarre aliens, Courage protects his home in the middle of Nowhere with hilarious yet spooky encounters.

allShows.title: Doraemon
allShows.description: A robotic cat from the 22nd century, Doraemon, travels back in time to help Nobita. Using futuristic gadgets, he tries to fix Nobita’s everyday problems, but often ends up in funny and chaotic adventures with his friends.

allShows.title: Jake and the Never Land Pirates
allShows.description: Jake and his crew of young pirates set sail across Never Land, facing challenges and collecting treasures. Together they outsmart the mischievous Captain Hook, proving that teamwork and friendship make them true pirates of adventure.

allShows.title: Kick Buttowski
allShows.description: Clarence “Kick” Buttowski dreams of being the world’s greatest daredevil. With fearless stunts, wild challenges, and endless determination, Kick constantly pushes the limits of danger and comedy in his small suburban town.

allShows.title: Kid vs Kat
allShows.description: When Coop’s sister adopts a strange hairless cat, life takes a turn for chaos. The cat is actually an evil alien plotting world domination, and Coop becomes the only one who knows the truth—leading to a never-ending battle of wits.

allShows.title: Kiteretsu
allShows.description: Kiteretsu is a boy genius who builds amazing inventions inspired by his ancestor’s encyclopedia. Along with his robot friend Korosuke, he explores science, friendship, and wild adventures that mix comedy with clever problem-solving.

allShows.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse
allShows.description: Mickey and his friends invite kids into a colorful clubhouse filled with fun, friendship, and problem-solving. Together with Minnie, Donald, Daisy, Goofy, and Pluto, Mickey uses teamwork and creativity to solve everyday challenges in magical ways.

allShows.title: Mr. Bean
allShows.description: Mr. Bean is eccentric, childlike, and hilariously unpredictable. With little dialogue and plenty of slapstick, he stumbles into ordinary situations that quickly spiral into chaotic misadventures, leaving laughter in his wake.

allShows.title: Ninja Hattori
allShows.description: Hattori is a skilled young ninja who comes to live with Kenichi, a mischievous schoolboy. Using his ninja skills, Hattori helps Kenichi with school, friends, and life’s problems, while also battling rival ninjas who threaten peace.

allShows.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
allShows.description: Oggy, a lazy cat, just wants to relax and enjoy life, but three pesky cockroaches—Joey, Dee Dee, and Marky—never let him. Their endless pranks lead to hilarious chases, over-the-top chaos, and slapstick comedy in every episode.

allShows.title: Oswald
allShows.description: Oswald the gentle octopus lives in Big City with his pet dog, Weenie. His calm and kind nature brings life lessons of patience, friendship, and positivity as he faces small adventures in everyday life.

allShows.title: Perman
allShows.description: Mitsuo, a young boy, is chosen to become “Perman,” a superhero who fights crime with special gadgets and powers. Balancing his double life as both a student and a hero, Mitsuo learns the importance of responsibility and courage.

allShows.title: Phineas and Ferb
allShows.description: Stepbrothers Phineas and Ferb spend every summer day creating outrageous inventions and wild projects. Meanwhile, their sister Candace tries to expose them, and their pet platypus Perry secretly lives a double life as a spy fighting evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

allShows.title: Pokemon
allShows.description: Join Ash Ketchum and his loyal Pikachu as they travel across regions to become Pokémon Masters. Along the way, they meet new friends, battle rivals, discover legendary creatures, and learn that true strength comes from friendship and teamwork.

allShows.title: Roll No 21
allShows.description: Kris, the modern-day avatar of Lord Krishna, battles evil in his school while disguising himself as an ordinary student. With clever tricks and divine wisdom, he defeats his enemy Kanishk and proves that good always triumphs over evil.

allShows.title: Shaun the Sheep
allShows.description: Shaun is a clever sheep who leads his flock into comical adventures on a quiet farm. From mischievous tricks to clever escapes, Shaun’s leadership often drags the farmer and the sheepdog Bitzer into lighthearted chaos.

allShows.title: Shinchan
allShows.description: Shinchan is a mischievous five-year-old whose wild antics drive his parents, teachers, and neighbors crazy. With cheeky humor, silly jokes, and unpredictable adventures, he manages to turn every ordinary day into pure comedy.

allShows.title: SpongeBob Square Pants
allShows.description: In the underwater city of Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob works at the Krusty Krab and goes on absurd adventures with his best friend Patrick. From jellyfishing to facing Plankton’s schemes, SpongeBob’s endless optimism makes every day hilariously unpredictable.

allShows.title: Strawberry Shortcake
allShows.description: In the sweet and colorful world of Strawberryland, Strawberry Shortcake and her friends go on heartwarming adventures. With lessons in kindness, friendship, and positivity, their journeys are as delightful as the desserts they love.

allShows.title: Tom and Jerry
allShows.description: One of the most iconic rivalries in animation, Tom the cat and Jerry the mouse engage in endless chases, traps, and slapstick comedy. Their timeless battles, filled with clever gags and explosive humor, remain a classic for all ages.
